Pair.description: maxItems not past them closes the tuple.

UpToTwo.description: Items past minItems up to maxItems are optional.

Some.description: Equal items in a row are repeated where that is shorter than writing each.

Objects.description: An object type is written once.

Empty.description: maxItems 0 admits only the empty array.

Head.description: With prefixItems, maxItems not past them closes the tuple.

Short.description: maxItems inside prefixItems leaves out the rest of them.

HeadUpTo.description: maxItems past prefixItems adds optional items of the items schema.

LongHead.description: prefixItems are repeated where they are equal.

Long.description: minItems past prefixItems requires items of the items schema.

Unreachable.description: minItems past prefixItems with items false admits nothing.

AtLeastTwo.description: minItems without type is an array.

Split.description: allOf members meet item by item.

SplitMax.description: maxItems in another member closes the tuple.

SplitClosed.description: minItems past a closed tuple in another member admits nothing.

NotArray.description: Array keywords constrain only arrays, so the strings type names pass them.
